en: Vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story European‑style buildings, balconies with flags, and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. The view looks straight down the street; the lower border contains captions in Greek and French identifying the location as an avenue named after Eleftherios Venizelos in Salonique (Thessaloniki). A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower center.
